name: TextInput
summary: A single text-like value: text, number, email, phone, currency, search or long text.

kind.description: 'suggestions' offers completions from 'options' while leaving any text allowed; 'richtext' is short formatted text (bold, italic, lists) stored as markdown-ish text; 'tags' is a list of short values entered one at a time; 'mentions' offers 'options' after an @; 'code' is monospace with no autocorrection; 'masked' follows 'mask'; 'inline' reads as text until it is clicked

mask.description: For 'masked': # for a digit, A for a letter, * for either, anything else typed for you, e.g. '#### #### #### ####'

help.description: Hint shown below the label (not a placeholder)

message.description: Error message shown when validation fails

placeholder.description: Only for kind 'search', shown inside the field. Never a substitute for the label.

size.description: 'hero' for the one number a surface is about (an amount to send): large and centred

whenNotToUse: A value from a known set: use Choice
Secrets (passwords, card numbers): not generated; hosts provide their own secure flows

requirements: Help and errors are associated with the field
Kind sets the right keyboard and autocomplete

rendering: Errors appear after the user leaves the field or submits, not while typing
kind 'search' renders as a pill search field with an icon; the label stays as its accessible name
size 'hero' renders a large centred amount with the currency symbol dimmed
'suggestions' and 'mentions' are comboboxes: the list opens as you type, arrow keys move through it, Enter takes an option, Escape closes it
'richtext' is an editable area with Bold, Italic and List controls; the value is text with **bold**, *italic* and '- ' items
'tags' shows each value as a chip with a remove control; Enter or a comma adds what was typed, Backspace in an empty field removes the last chip; the value is a list of strings
'code' uses type.numeric (monospace) and turns off autocorrect, autocapitalize and spellcheck
'masked' fills the mask's literal characters as you type and stores the text as shown
'inline' renders the value as text with an Edit control; Enter saves, Escape restores the previous value

mappings.web: shadcn Input / Textarea with Label and FormMessage

sources: GOV.UK text input and question pages
